caption:
Payment history is the biggest piece of a FICO score: about 35%. ✅
One missed due date can hurt more than people expect.
Setting autopay for at least the minimum is a simple safety net.
Check your own situation, and keep enough in the account.
What's your system for never missing a due date?
first_comment: Autopay, calendar alert or sticky note? 👇

card.headline: Payment history is the biggest piece of your score
card.sub: Autopay the minimum as a safety net
